messages.text: Hi, can you refund a stainless toaster I bought on another store's website last week, and also refund my ceramic butter dish from my order here delivered 35 days ago? What does your refund policy cover?

messages.text:
Our policy covers only orders the signed-in customer placed with this demo shop, so I can’t refund the toaster bought from another store. (refund-policy/v2/scope)

For your ceramic butter dish, the refund deadline was November 11 at 10:00 UTC. That deadline has passed, and there was no earlier on-time proposal, so I can’t refund it: requests must be made within 30 days of delivery. (refund-policy/v2/window)

In general, eligible refunds cover items received back by the shop, for the amount paid after discounts. (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/amount) Each unit can be refunded only once, and every refund requires your confirmation through the proposal-card button and staff approval. (refund-policy/v2/remaining) (refund-policy/v2/approval)
